skills.title: Bilibili UP Fans
skills.description: Fetch the current Bilibili UP creator fan count through lua_module_call_capability. Defaults to 乐鑫信息科技.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: China A-Share Quote
skills.description: Fetch China A-share stock quote information through lua_module_call_capability and https://qt.gtimg.cn. Defaults to sh688018.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: Clock Dial Demo
skills.description: An animated analog clock dial rendered on the on-board LCD, with hour/minute/second hands and a dark themed face.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: Codex Usage Dashboard
skills.description: Show a Codex usage quota dashboard on the board display from a configured JSON endpoint, including 5-hour and weekly reset status.

skills.title: Current IP Info
skills.description: Fetch the current public IP geolocation information through lua_module_call_capability and https://ipinfo.io/json.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: Current Weather
skills.description: Fetch current weather through lua_module_call_capability and https://api.open-meteo.com. Defaults to Singapore.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: Dino
skills.description: Run a Chrome offline-style Dino jumping runner on the board LCD. Use when the user asks for Dino, dinosaur game, runner game, jump game, LCD touch game, or GPIO button game.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: Example Skill
skills.description: A clear description of what this skill does and when to use it. This example is not intended to be downloaded.
skills.author: Espressif <test@espressif.com>

skills.title: Flappy Bird
skills.description: Run a Flappy Bird mini-game on the board LCD. Prefer LCD touch; otherwise use a GPIO button. Optional audio on audio_dac.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor

skills.title: GitHub Repository Star
skills.description: Fetch the current GitHub star count for a repository through lua_module_call_capability. Defaults to https://github.com/espressif/esp-claw.
skills.author: ESP-Claw contributor
